cause: Windows global core.autocrlf=true converted JSON LF to CRLF at checkout
amendment: post-outcome packaging attributes only; no experiment rerun or frozen execution source change

attempts.note: Checkout retained old CRLF working-copy bytes despite new attributes; remote Git blob and all archive parts were unchanged.

resolution: Canonical sealed metadata is read from the network-fetched Git blobs; exact stored bytes are materialized and then hashed. This changes no remote Git object or scientific data.
